findings.reader: A well-bounded daily brief that answers the subscriber's real question: it cleanly separates the subscription's five-hour usage allowance and saveable reset from developer per-token API billing, keeps every provider claim attributed, flags what Anthropic did not publish (increase size, message counts, plan-by-plan selector access), and gives one concrete proportionate action. No failure families present; mechanism supports both causal explain-back and transfer to unseen cases.
findings.facts: All six material claims verify against the official Anthropic announcement excerpts: the September 22 date, $4/$20 per-million-token API prices, five-hour limit increases on the four named plans, the saveable reset, the migrations/audits task positioning, and the Fable 5.1 comparison. Attribution and source limitations are preserved throughout, and the access-boundary negative claim accurately reflects the source's silence on plan-by-plan chat selector access. Fully reviewable with dates and one traceable source; no factual defects.
